name: oil-find
title: Oil Find
description: Search files with Oil Find from Raycast, using its index, filters and search syntax.
author: edgardmello

commands.name: search-files
commands.title: Search Files with Oil Find
commands.subtitle: Oil Find
commands.description: Search files and folders in the Oil Find index. Supports Oil Find syntax such as *.pdf, in:~/Documents, dm:week and size:>10mb, plus the filters from your Oil Find library.

preferences.name: applicationPath
preferences.title: Oil Find App Path
preferences.description: Absolute path to Oil Find.app or a development build. Leave blank to use the app in Applications.

preferences.name: showDetail
preferences.title: Details
preferences.label: Show the preview panel by default

preferences.name: terminalApp
preferences.title: Terminal
preferences.description: Used by Open Folder in Terminal. Defaults to Terminal.

preferences.name: editorApp
preferences.title: Editor
preferences.description: Adds an Open in Editor action when set.
